verdict.rationale: Runloop's Devboxes are full sandboxed Linux environments where you can execute commands/code (docs-59, docs-61, docs-62) and blueprints can be built from Dockerfiles to support any language runtime (docs-2, docs-3), implying multi-language support. However, the evidence never explicitly documents Python/JavaScript-specific execution APIs or 'rich' structured result formats (e.g., images, dataframes) as in a code-interpreter product — execution is framed generically around shell commands, logs, and PTYs rather than language-aware rich outputs. Missing for 10: explicit multi-language runtime docs (Python/JS SDK code-exec examples), evidence of rich/structured result payloads (images, tables, exceptions) beyond raw logs/stdout.
